# Seasons reference

## Points needed per division

A season is 10 matches: win 3 points, draw 1, loss 0. Final points decide the outcome. "—" means the outcome does not exist in that division.

| Division | Relegated | Stay up | Promotion | Title |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | — | 0 | 9 | 12 |
| 9 | below 7 | 7 | 11 | 14 |
| 8 | below 9 | 9 | 16 | 19 |
| 7 | below 10 | 10 | 15 | 18 |
| 6 | below 12 | 12 | 17 | 20 |
| 5 | below 13 | 13 | 19 | 22 |
| 4 | below 14 | 14 | 21 | 24 |
| 3 | below 14 | 14 | 21 | 24 |
| 2 | below 14 | 14 | 21 | 24 |
| 1 | below 15 | 15 | — | 30 |

## Match and title packs per division

Every Seasons match also drops one untradeable pack chosen by result. Winning the title adds one more pack.

| Division | Win pack | Draw pack | Loss pack | Title pack |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | Premium Bronze | Bronze | Bronze | Bronze |
| 9 | Premium Bronze | Bronze | Bronze | Premium Bronze |
| 8 | Silver | Premium Bronze | Bronze | Silver |
| 7 | Silver | Premium Bronze | Bronze | Premium Silver |
| 6 | Premium Silver | Silver | Premium Bronze | Gold |
| 5 | Premium Silver | Silver | Premium Bronze | Premium Gold |
| 4 | Gold | Premium Silver | Silver | Jumbo Premium Gold |
| 3 | Gold | Premium Silver | Silver | Premium Gold Players |
| 2 | Premium Gold | Gold | Premium Silver | Mega |
| 1 | Premium Gold | Gold | Premium Silver | Rare Players |

## Competitions

Each division offers several competitions. Their 10 fixtures have fixed difficulties, shown as letters: **B** Beginner, **A** Amateur, **S** Semi-Pro, **P** Professional, **W** World Class, **L** Legendary, **U** Ultimate. End-of-season coins are the average of the difficulty table over all 10 scheduled fixtures, rounded down.
